description: This file implements the 'Edit' feature for articles in an ASP.NET Core application, including command validation, handling article updates, and managing associated tags.

classes.name: Edit
classes.description: Contains the classes and handlers related to editing articles, including command definitions, validation, and the handler logic.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Processes the article edit command, updates the article and tags in the database, and returns the updated article envelope.

methods.name: GetArticleTagsToCreate
methods.description: Determines which tags need to be added to the article based on the provided tag list.

methods.name: GetArticleTagsToDelete
methods.description: Determines which existing tags should be removed from the article based on the provided tag list.
